excerpt: Just drop it into ReelMimic. A file, a phone recording or a YouTube link all work. Then tell it what you want to make.
Breaks down the reference. Shot count, shot lengths, BPM, transitions, colors, framing and camera moves.
Shows you the plan first. Storyboard, characters, assets and a few style frames. Chat about it until you like it, then approve.
If you want changes, say so in the chat on the right. Screenshots work too.
Up to 6 work on different parts of the video. Each finished shot goes to a new agent for review, so nobody grades their own work.
Fixes need proof. Every fix comes with before and after screenshots, and the reviewer checks them.
You can see what it's doing. What each agent is thinking, what it ran, which frames it looked at. The full log is there too.
The Production line tab shows where each character and each part of the video is, with the review screenshots.
Comment right on the video. When it's done, scrub to any second and type a note. Send them all at once.
New styles are just Markdown. One file per style, no code.
2D only, seven drawing engines: vector / motion graphics..., hand-painted watercolor..., crayon picture book, pixel art, paper cut-out stop-motion, whiteboard doodle, and anime cel.
When a reference doesn't match a known style, it uses the closest engine and writes up a proposal for a new style.
The whole thing runs on your own computer, with your own Claude Code or Codex.
If you hit a limit, the job pauses and can pick up where it stopped.
The install script checks your setup and tells you if anything's missing. You can run the check again any time with `cd app && npm run doctor`.
BUILDERS, MAX_AGENTS — How many agents work on one video at once (default 6), and the limit across all projects (default 12)
YATING_KEY: Yating's Taiwanese Mandarin voices, for narration. ELEVENLABS_API_KEY: Optional ElevenLabs TTS
More images, music and sound effects you're allowed to use (optional, Openverse works without a key)
Characters are original unless you bring your own designs, in which case it follows yours.
npm run post-video -- <project id> --platforms tiktok --at 2026-10-05T18:00 --tz Europe/Madrid --send
On the home page, drop in a reference video or paste a link, say what you want, and pick Claude Code or Codex.
Extending: adding styles, rendering engines, or another AI
Three languages. 繁體中文, English and 简体中文, switch in the top right.
